public_api_path_control.scope: Unmodified pinned full-library public API; owned path strings only, no actual file or host integration

findings: Cross-agent path map joins paths using semicolons and splits without escaping. Same /src/a;b.rs is missed across agents and unseen /src/a is falsely detected; the miss survives actual JSON roundtrip. Ordinary-path control passes.
The exact output-redundancy fast path compares FNV64 hash plus byte length; no byte confirmation is performed. Display short_hex retains32bits but is not the full comparison key.
Shingle sketch is capped96 after allocating all tokens and all trigram hashes, sorting and deduplicating. Final sketch cap is not a peak working-memory bound. No allocator measurement performed.
Fuzzy redundancy deliberately tolerates whitespace and changed lines, whereas one/two-token sketches are empty; this is output compression, not a file-identity contract.
Blob storage rewrites digest-addressed files directly using fs::write and verifies FNV on retrieval; no atomic publication or concurrent-writer qualification in this review.
transfer_decision: No production implementation copied. Preserve typed paths and keep digest/sketch candidate matching separate from exact file-byte confirmation.
limits: 13/327 whole-file reviews; cache module only selected methods.
Original37 tests and finite owned path control do not qualify host hooks, all cache behavior, performance or universal recall.
